correctness.rationale: For infinite locally finite rooted tree and c_v>0, the root-plus-ℓ∞ weighted increment coordinates are onto. Conjugated nonroot row has diagonal ψ(v), root coefficient β_v, ancestor coefficients β_v/c_w. With finite-depth P_K, F_K=P_KA+(I−P_K)AP_K is finite rank and remainder tail norm equals E_K. For lower bound choose disjoint depth-band sign/phase alignments: bounded disjointly supported ℓ∞ vectors are weakly null (finite additivity/dual norm argument), and any compact map vanishes on them, yielding ≥lim E_K. Root/max equivalent direct sum does not change the zero-root tail. Exponential ray c_n=2^n, ψ_n=2^-n yields E_K=2^-K and c_n|Δψ_n|=1. Independently checked 120 finite row/truncation cases. Mathematical formula correct, but separate published work already proves its substantive result.
